description:
Validates vault files against the adulting schemas.

Usage: lint [PATH ...] [--schemas DIR] [--quiet]

Args:
  PATH  files to validate. Default: walk the whole vault.

Flags:
  --schemas DIR  schemas directory. Default: the schemas bundled with the package.
  --quiet        suppress per-violation output; report by exit code only

Examples:
  []
  ["notes/2026-09-10-14-30-00.md"]
  ["--quiet"]

Notes:
  Read-only. Violations print as PATH:LINE: MESSAGE.
  Exit code 0 means clean. 1 means violations were found. 2 means no schemas could be loaded.
